title: 8.1.3. Abhidhammacittamissakavisesa
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Yassa kusalaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati …pe… yassa akusalaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati … yassa abyākataṁ cittaṁ uppajjati … yassa sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati … ?
Yassa araṇaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa araṇaṁ cittaṁ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati?
Yassa vā pana araṇaṁ cittaṁ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati tassa araṇaṁ cittaṁ uppajjati na nirujjhati?
